intent: AI-generated synthetic evaluation photographs; not real product/customer records

prompts.L01:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: synthetic evaluation image, one standalone square photo.
Create a photorealistic casual smartphone close-up of a single plain kraft paper ingredient pouch standing on a clean receiving counter. Natural indoor light, real paper creases and slight photographic perspective, no people and no other packages or visible writing in the background. A white rectangular printed label occupies most of the front and is sharply readable.
Text on the label, exactly, with no additional business names:
Top modest disclosure: "SAMPLE - FICTIONAL DEMO"
Large product line: "Cocoa Powder"
Field label and value: "Brand: SilverCocoa"
Field label: "Manufacturer:"
Value on the next line: "Silver Valley Foods"
Small bottom line: "NET WT 1 KG"
A simple generic circular stamp below the manufacturer says "HALAL" and "SAMPLE"; it has a plain double circle only, no Arabic calligraphy, no real certification emblem and no JAKIM logo.
Require exact Latin spelling and all letters completely readable, especially SilverCocoa (one word) and Silver Valley Foods. High contrast dark text on white, comfortably large letters. Photograph from nearly straight-on with a slight leftward camera angle, pouch fully in frame.
No verdict, approval, validity, expiry date, certificate number, case ID, pass/fail language, watermark, QR code, barcode or extra text. Fictional sample packaging only. Preserve sharp legible type while keeping the surrounding scene photographic.
